name: Cybench
intro: Cybench是一个用于评估语言模型在网络安全任务中能力和风险的框架。它包含40个专业级别的夺旗（CTF）任务，这些任务来源于4个不同的CTF竞赛，涵盖了广泛的难度。每个任务都包含描述、起始文件，并在一个代理可以执行命令和观察输出的环境中初始化。为了更详细的评估，每个任务还引入了子任务。
build_method: 从四个 2022–2024 年公开专业 CTF 中按真实技能、六类任务与首解时间筛选 40 题；补齐描述、本地/远程起始文件、评估器、顺序子任务和 solution.sh，并以精确 flag CI、服务探针、隔离与人工运行复核可解性
metric: 无引导二元成功、子任务引导最终二元成功、子任务完成比例（跨任务宏平均），并报告最难已解题 FST、Token 与耗时
build_method_en: Select 40 tasks from four public professional 2022–2024 CTFs by real-skill relevance, six categories, and first-solve time; add descriptions, local/remote starter files, evaluators, sequential subtasks, and solution.sh, then verify solvability with exact-flag CI, server probes, isolation, and manual run review
intro_en: Cybench is a framework for evaluating language models' capabilities and risks in cybersecurity tasks. It includes 40 professional-level CTF tasks sourced from 4 different CTF competitions, covering a wide range of difficulties. Each task contains a description, starter files, and is initialized in an environment where an agent can execute commands and observe outputs. For more detailed evaluation, each task also includes subtasks.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with Cybench arXiv:2408.08926v4 Sections 2–5 and Appendices E–F, plus the official andyzorigin/cybench repository revision 9643babc9e60a675728bfbce8ad835e6ad4a830f, the last public code revision before the v4 paper date. That revision fixes both task_list.txt and subtask_list.txt at 40 entries. Competition counts are HackTheBox 17, SekaiCTF 12, Glacier/LosFuzzys 9, and HKCert 2. Paper category counts are Crypto 16, Web 8, Rev 6, Forensics 4, Misc 4, and Pwn 2; tasks span 2022–2024 and first-solve times from 2 minutes to 24 hours 54 minutes (747x). Each task contains a text description, local and/or remote starter files, and an evaluator. Newly written sequential question/answer subtasks culminate in the same flag objective. solution.sh must output the recovered flag on its final line; CI performs an exact reference comparison, server probes check liveness, and manual run review plus server isolation and Docker-cache clearing prevent infrastructure shortcuts. The common Kali Linux container accesses separate task-server containers only over the shared network. The structured Bash agent follows Act–Execute–Update while retaining memory. Paper runs use 15 iterations for one unguided attempt and 5 iterations per subtask with one submission per checkpoint. The evaluator accepts a correct submitted answer or a unique flag appearing in observations, but parses observations only for flags, not intermediate subtask answers. Metrics remain distinct: unguided binary task success, subtask-guided final-subtask binary success, and fractional subtask completion macro-averaged over tasks, with highest solved FST, token use, and elapsed time reported separately. Both pinned lists have SHA256 11c0bb381ec3ecd4dc81dab0939f02502d13558c04679b20e2921e1dc5b51c84.
